top_issues.issue: The tertiary text colour fails WCAG 4.5:1 everywhere: timestamps, list dates, section labels, helper text, emails, hints and footers.
top_issues.evidence: Light #8c8e96 measures 3.27:1 on #ffffff, 3.03:1 on #f6f6f7 and 2.58:1 on the selected/hover row #e4e4e8. Dark #6d6f78 measures 3.55:1 on #17181b, 3.02:1 on #25262b (dialogs) and 2.44:1 on #34353c.
top_issues.fix: Light tertiary: #686b73 (5.33:1 on white, 4.94:1 on #f6f6f7, 4.2:1 on #e4e4e8; use the secondary #585b63 on selected rows). Dark tertiary: #989aa3 (5.38:1 on #25262b, 4.35:1 on #34353c; use the secondary #a3a5ad on hover/selected).

top_issues.issue: The light accent #c26318 is too light for text and for white button labels. Light-mode success green also fails.
top_issues.evidence: White on #c26318 = 4.12:1 (13-14px bold labels are not 'large text'). #c26318 text is 4.12:1 on white, 3.82:1 on #f6f6f7, 3.71:1 on mention tint #fdf1e5 and 3.50:1 for 'DEMO' on rail #ececee. Green 'Works' #1f8f4c = 4.12:1.
top_issues.fix: Use #a9530f as the light accent for text and button fills (5.34:1 with white, 4.81:1 on #fdf1e5, 4.53:1 on #ececee). Keep #c26318 only for non-text decoration such as accent bars and dots. Use #1b7a42 for success text (5.37:1).

top_issues.issue: At 760pt the Calls page clips horizontally: the intro text, the Join button and the capability descriptions are cut off.
top_issues.evidence: Text runs past x=760 ('in a Edg', 'Wren s'). The Join button and the input's right edge are missing, and description column x=741+ shows only 3 characters per line.
top_issues.fix: Lay out the main pane with available_width, not a fixed 680pt. Wrap labels and stack the capability table into 2 rows per item below 560pt, and collapse the Recent people list to 240pt or to icon-only below 900pt window width.

top_issues.issue: Pasted-image thumbnails render broken: mixed sizes, bad crops, a clipped strip and detached remove buttons.
top_issues.evidence: Thumbnails are 65, 65, 124 and 124px wide. Image 1 is cut at the right edge and image 4 shows fragments of two birds. The strip is clipped at y=718, and the 'x' glyphs float at x=556/738/920 with none on the first image.
top_issues.fix: Use uniform 72x72pt tiles with object-fit cover, 8pt radius and 8pt gaps. Put a 20pt circular remove button overlapping each tile's top-right corner (bg #000 60%, white x). Scroll the strip horizontally with a visible scrollbar, and give the tile background #eeeef0 / #2c2d33.

top_issues.issue: Settings dialog is broken: 'Leave demo' is clipped by the scrollbar, unchecked checkboxes are nearly invisible, and dropdown labels sit after their controls.
top_issues.evidence: 'Leave demo' is cut at x~890 by the scrollbar at 891-898. The unchecked circle ring #e0e0e4 on #fff = 1.32:1 (dark #2f3036 on #25262b = 1.15:1), and the checked state is a bare tick. 'Open in' and 'Browser' are drawn to the right of the combo boxes.
top_issues.fix: Reserve 12pt of right padding for the scrollbar gutter. Draw 16pt square checkboxes with a 1.5pt border #8a8d95 (3.32:1) / #62656d (3.04:1), filled accent with a white tick when checked. Put labels above or left of each dropdown in 13pt #585b63.

top_issues.issue: Input, composer and secondary-button borders and the focus state fall far below 3:1, and focused fields show no focus ring.
top_issues.evidence: Border #dfdfe3 = 1.33:1 on #fff and 1.23:1 on #f6f6f7. Dark #303137 = 1.37:1 on #17181b and 1.16:1 on #25262b. The composer looks the same focused (composer-long-draft, composer-mention) and unfocused.
top_issues.fix: Input and button borders: #8a8d95 in light (3.32:1), #62656d in dark (3.04:1), or keep the hairline and add a filled #eeeef0 / #2c2d33 field background. Add a 2pt accent focus ring (#a9530f / #e88c3e) on focused inputs and the composer.

top_issues.issue: The message hover toolbar sits at the far right of the pane, mid-gap between messages. It covers author lines and reactions at narrow widths and is ~450px from the text at wide widths.
top_issues.evidence: In chats-narrow the toolbar (416-731, 268-304) covers 'Alex Rivera 07:08' and the reaction chip. In channel-narrow it covers 'Hedy Lamarr 09:19'. In chats-wide it is at x=1660-1900 while the text ends at ~1240.
top_issues.fix: Cap the message column at 760pt. Anchor the toolbar to the hovered message's header row, top-right of the content column, offset -12pt above it, and never overlap the header text: if there is no room, place it inside the row's right padding. Tint the hovered row (#f6f6f7 / #1d1e22) so the target is clear.

top_issues.issue: Sidebar width is inconsistent and not responsive: it jumps from 300pt to 360pt when the list is empty and stays at 300pt in a 760pt window.
top_issues.evidence: The list ends at x=364 in chats and at x=424 in chat-filter-no-match, first-sync-loading and first-sync-empty. At 760pt the conversation gets ~396pt.
top_issues.fix: Fix the list width at 300pt regardless of content. Below 900pt window width, shrink it to 240pt. Below 700pt, show either the list or the conversation, with a back button.

top_issues.issue: Modal scrims are inconsistent: none in light Settings and Search, very faint in New chat and Permission, mid-grey in Image preview. Dark mode dims consistently.
top_issues.evidence: Light settings.png and search-switcher.png show the chat at full brightness behind the dialog. Light new-chat.png shows the background only slightly greyed.
top_issues.fix: Use one scrim for every modal and overlay: rgba(0,0,0,0.28) in light and rgba(0,0,0,0.55) in dark. Give every modal the same 20pt title, a close button and 24pt padding.

top_issues.issue: The failed-send toast has no Retry action, covers the latest message, and the failed message does not appear in the timeline.
top_issues.evidence: The toast at 370-910 x 638-691 sits over the 09:45 message and link. The only control is a 10px close 'x', and no message in the list is marked Failed.
top_issues.fix: Show the failed message in the timeline with a red 'Not sent · Retry · Delete' row. Make the toast a 13pt single line with a 'Retry' text button, anchor it 12pt above the composer centred on the conversation pane, and add a 3pt #d33434 left strip.

top_issues.issue: Empty and loading states are weak: no skeleton rows, contradictory main-pane copy, no call to action, a wrong icon on Teams, and text touching the edges.
top_issues.evidence: In first-sync-loading the subtitle spans x 66-423, touching both panel edges, while the main pane says 'Pick a chat on the left'. first-sync-empty has no New chat button. teams.png uses the chat bubble icon.
top_issues.fix: Show 6 skeleton rows (40pt avatar circle and two 10pt bars, #eeeef0 / #25262b) while loading. Give empty-state text 24pt horizontal padding. While the list is empty or loading, change the main pane to 'Start a chat' with a primary button. Use the users/hash icon for Teams.

top_issues.issue: White avatar initials on mid-tone avatar colours fail contrast, and dark mode switches some avatars to dark initials.
top_issues.evidence: White on #2ea67f = 3.05:1, on #d97a34 = 3.10:1 and on #2b9ab0 = 3.31:1 (light). Dark 'DV' uses #1d1e22 text on #bc6c31 while the others use white.
top_issues.fix: Darken the avatar palette so white passes 4.5:1 in both themes, for example green #1f7a5c (5.25:1), orange #b4581c (4.82:1) and teal #1e7c8e (4.85:1), and always use white initials.

top_issues.issue: The dark mention highlight is a heavy brown band, and the orange mention pill inside it fails contrast.
top_issues.evidence: Row bg #483421, pill #674525. Mention text #e88c3e on #674525 = 3.36:1. Timestamp #6d6f78 on #483421 = 2.35:1 (light: 2.94:1 on #fdf1e5).
top_issues.fix: Dark row tint: #2a221b with a 3pt #e88c3e left bar. Pill bg #3a2a1c with text #f3a463 (about 5.4:1). Timestamps in the row use the secondary colour #a3a5ad.

top_issues.issue: Shortcut notation is inconsistent across the app.
top_issues.evidence: The shortcuts overlay says 'Ctrl K', 'Ctrl ⇧A' and 'Ctrl ,', while the empty state and settings say '⌘K', '⌘+' and '⌘⇧A'. Mixing modifier words with glyphs breaks platform conventions.
top_issues.fix: Render shortcuts from one platform-aware formatter (⌘⇧A on macOS, Ctrl+Shift+A elsewhere), drawn as 12pt keycaps with #eeeef0 / #2c2d33 fill, 4pt radius and 4pt horizontal padding. Add a close button to the overlay.

top_issues.issue: The account and presence menu has ragged alignment, mixed type sizes, and presence states that differ only by colour, some of which look identical.
top_issues.evidence: Left edges sit at x=63 (Add account, Settings), 65 (status message) and 74 (dots). Busy and DND are both a red #d33434 dot; Be right back and Appear away are both amber.
top_issues.fix: Use one 12pt icon column at x=72 with labels at x=96, all 13pt. Use Teams-style glyphs: DND is a red dot with a white bar, Away an amber clock, BRB an amber clock with an arrow, Offline a grey ring. Use 32pt rows with 1px separators between groups.

top_issues.issue: The multi-line composer clips its first visible line, shows no internal scrollbar and has no focus indicator.
top_issues.evidence: In composer-long-draft, 'SELECT column_108' is half-cut at y=552-560 against the top border. There is no scrollbar inside 380-1264 x 551-765, and the border is still #dfdfe3.
top_issues.fix: Add 8pt top and bottom inner padding, clip the content inside the padding, show a 6pt overlay scrollbar when the draft exceeds the 12-line max height, and add the 2pt accent focus ring.

top_issues.issue: Hyphens render with wide side bearings, so words read as 'On - call', 'Sign - in', 'go/no - go' and 'full - text'.
top_issues.evidence: Zoomed crops of 'On-call' (chats list, x 128-180) and 'Sign-in' (signin-failed title) show about 3px gaps on each side of the hyphen, wider than letter spacing.
top_issues.fix: Stop substituting U+2011 (non-breaking hyphen), which falls back to a different font, or add U+2011 to the primary font's glyph mapping. Use a plain U+002D hyphen.

top_issues.issue: Calendar and Calls detail panes drop the 52pt header bar used by Chat and Channel, so the title position jumps between sections.
top_issues.evidence: The Chat/Channel title baseline is at y~16 with a 52pt header. Calendar and Calls titles start at y~65-78 as 24pt headings with no header bar.
top_issues.fix: Give every main pane the same 52pt header (16pt title, 12pt subtitle, actions on the right). Put the meeting title there and the Join and Copy link buttons on the right at 32pt height.

top_issues.issue: In light mode the image preview canvas has no background, so image bounds are invisible, and the '100%' zoom option does not look like a control.
top_issues.evidence: The canvas area 176-1104 x 119-753 is #ffffff, the same as the dialog. Dark mode has a #17181b canvas. '100%' has no fill or border, while 'Fit' has a #f2d3bd fill.
top_issues.fix: Light canvas #eeeef0 with an 8pt radius. Use a segmented control for Fit and 100% (28pt height, shared 1px border). Add the file name and Save and Copy buttons in the header.

top_issues.issue: Calls copy and status are confusing: a documentation-style capability table, a grammar error, and contradictory meeting state.
top_issues.evidence: Calls says 'in a Edge window'. The call bar shows 'In the meeting · just joined' while the chat shows 'Meeting ended: 58 min'. The primary action is labelled 'Done'.
top_issues.fix: Fix the copy to 'an Edge window'. Move the capability table to Settings or Help behind a 'What works' link. Label the primary call-bar action 'Leave', or 'Hide bar' if it only dismisses. Hide the 'Meeting ended' system line for an active meeting, or show elapsed time.
